subject: Reminder: Add/Drop period ends this Friday
body: Dear Students, Please be reminded that the add/drop period for Semester A 2026/27 ends this Friday at 5:00 pm. Changes to course registration will not be accepted after this deadline. Please log in to AIMS to finalise your enrolment. Student Records Office

subject: IMPORTANT: Kitchen hygiene rules
body: Dear Residents, We have noticed that the shared kitchens on floors 5-8 have been left untidy. Please clean up after cooking and do not leave food in the sink. Thank you for your cooperation. Hall Office

subject: GE2340: Phase 2 deliverables
body: Dear all, a reminder that Phase 2 deliverables (report, slides, video link and contribution statement) are due on 30 November at 11:59 pm. Late submissions will not be accepted. Teaching Team

subject: Exchange Student Mid-Autumn Gathering
body: Hi exchange students! Join us for a Mid-Autumn celebration with mooncakes and lanterns on 6 October, 7 pm at the Student Residence. Free entry, register via the link if you are interested.
